name: Rescript
long_description:
Rescript is using AI to make the law transparent, accessible, and easy to act on. Laws and regulations differ across jurisdictions and are constantly changing, making them too complex for organizations to review and track manually at scale. We're building an agentic AI platform capable of aggregating and interpreting global regulations, tracking how they change, and identifying how organizations should respond. 

Our customers span AmLaw100 law firms, Fortune 100 corporations, and top trade associations across healthcare, retail, fintech and more. They depend on Rescript to help them comply with and act on an ever-changing regulatory landscape from the federal level down to individual cities.  

We're backed by YC, General Catalyst, and Floodgate.

launches.title: Rescript — AI Regulatory Analyst for Enterprises
launches.tagline: We track emerging policies and create well-researched compliance and advocacy materials.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** [Rescript](https://rescript.ai/) helps regulatory compliance and advocacy teams monitor, analyze, and act on the never-ending stream of regulatory and political developments.

**Problem:** 

Regulatory lawyers and lobbyists guide companies through constantly changing legal and political environments and are paid tens of billions of dollars every year to do so.

But there’s too much to track manually: to identify any new risk or opportunity in the US alone, they have to monitor 150,000+ laws introduced, 300,000+ hours of government hearings, and thousands of new regulations and enforcement suits every year.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83747&key=user_uploads/912498/4e8e332c-8c30-49ec-a086-b4e6099706e6)

**Solution:**

Rescript automates this process from end to end. We’ve built AI agents that scrape legislation and regulation as it changes, identify what’s relevant for you, and help you create well-researched compliance and advocacy materials.

1. **Exhaustive Tracking:** Rescript’s AI Agents scan the web and create detailed analyses of everything you need, including hearings, regulations, news, and press releases.  
2. **Intelligent Filtering:** Our tool uses human-like reasoning to determine if a new development involves the user’s policy issues. No more dealing with keywords. 
3. **Personalized Analysis:** Collaborate with AI to translate regulatory updates into actionable insights for internal business and compliance teams.

**The Team:** 

[Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-ajjarapu/) previously worked as a consultant for the DoD and built software for major federal agencies with Salesforce’s Public Sector team. He graduated magna cum laude from Princeton, where he studied Computer Science and earned minors in History & Public Policy.

[Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-pesendorfer/) previously worked in software engineering at a leading derivatives marketplace. He graduated summa cum laude from Princeton with a BSE in Computer Science and minors in Statistics, Machine Learning, and Finance.

[Vince](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vincentjh/) holds an MS in Computer Science and a BA in Philosophy from Stanford and previously staffed the House Science Committee in Congress.

**Working with us**

Rescript is already used by top-10-ranked government relations firms and AmLaw 200 law firms.

If you’re interested in learning more, please [schedule a time with us here for a 15-minute demo](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ2QGC5HMWdnOcDcz1cPXamWS8qKzQWFktlQLupOBtY50W-JOfXsHabKGx6u7Nod59taBnm7-dYe), or message us at [team@rescript.ai](mailto:team@rescript.ai).
